details:
I am Japanese, and while I can understand English to some extent,but I mainly rely on translation tools for reading and writing.

Also, since I wasn't sure which tag to use for this post, I apologize for posting it here.

I have a question regarding the “Instance Behavior” section of the Community Guidelines. Specifically, I have questions about the following points:

- Privately hosted instances that are publicly advertised are considered public instances for moderation purposes.

- Restrictions on provocative behavior do not apply to private instances, provided that all participants consent.

I am currently planning to host a hospitality event in a “strictly invitation-only private space,” during which there is a possibility that behavior classified as NSFW (not suitable for the workplace or public spaces) may occur.

However, considering the two points above together, is my understanding correct that “even if the event takes place in a completely private space, with verification that all participants are 18 or older and the consent of all participants secured, if the event is promoted on social media, SNS, or other web platforms, the rules for public instances will apply, and it will be treated as a violation of the guidelines”?

Is this understanding correct?
title: Confirmation of the Interpretation of Guidelines Regarding Events That Include NSFW Content
